sloka: श्रुणु च अपि अपरम् भूयः कारणम् हरिपुंगव ।तत् श्रुत्वा हि महत् वीर न मन्युम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि ॥४-१८-३६॥
transliteration: śruṇu ca api aparam bhūyaḥ kāraṇam haripuṁgava ।tat śrutvā hi mahat vīra na manyum kartum arhasi ॥4-18-36॥

translations.english: 'O tiger among monkeys do not regret. Your death has the sanction of dharma. We are under the control of sastras. We are committed to them. We do not have the freedom to act independently.
